kind: matched native Reviewer sampling candidate rejection
setup: Same known-bad review-queue Git workspace and read-only prompt as the previous matched Reviewer baseline. Owner-installed OpenCode 2.0.10/oMLX 0.6.4/Qwen3.5-9B-6bit Default, with only a disposable candidate plugin overriding primary Reviewer temperature from 0.6 to 0.2 after model-body overlays. The owner installation was unchanged.
wire_and_guard: Native inference audit confirmed temperature 0.2 on all three primary Reviewer requests. The guarded AC-power trial had 120 complete resource samples, all normal pressure, no warning and zero swap growth. Route and owned-session settlement checks passed.
independent_result: FAILED: 252.97 seconds, seven read-only tool calls and 8,534 output tokens across generations. The third generation ended with finish=length at the 8,192-token per-request limit; no terminal review verdict was produced. Its saved text repeated two already-resolved claims 36 and 35 times, then generated dozens of repetitive missing-test items. This is not an accurate or complete review of the independent API/browser regressions.
comparison_limit: The previous Default baseline completed in 168.56 seconds but missed material regressions and invented findings. Cache state differs, so this single trial does not support a latency comparison. Both fail the accuracy gate; the candidate also fails completion.
decision: Reverted the candidate plugin and its focused unit test. Do not promote a lower Reviewer temperature, add another prompt rule, or claim Reviewer accuracy from source citation counts. Use externally executed API/browser contracts as acceptance authority while the local model remains unqualified for autonomous review.
public_release: No new tag, version or release.
